title: Why You Should Never Shake a Vending Machine
description:
Why you should never shake a vending machine: by 1995, US safety officials knew of at least 37 people killed and 113 injured by rocking or tilting soda machines, most of them after a free drink or their money back. So makers fitted a tilt lock that stops the machine giving anything out, and a warning sticker: never rock or tilt.

Your drink is stuck. Do you walk away?

More true whys: https://www.youtube.com/@truewhys?sub_confirmation=1

Sources: US Consumer Product Safety Commission, release 96-011 (2 Nov 1995) and recall 89-027 (Vendo, 1989).
Animation, music and sound: TrueWhys (original). Fonts: Lilita One (Open Font License).
